About The Role

The role serves as the analytical bridge between business operations and technical data infrastructure. This position sits within the centralized business analytics team to transform raw transactional, user behavior, and financial data into actionable, automated intelligence for executive decision-making.

The role requires a blend of advanced SQL expertise, data visualization prowess, and a strong understanding of SaaS business metrics. The analyst will collaborate closely with product, finance, and engineering teams to design reliable data models and ensure key metrics are defined, measured, and socialized consistently.

Design, build, and maintain production-grade dashboards in Tableau or Looker to track core business KPIs and operational metrics
Write complex, optimized SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze datasets containing millions of rows across cloud data warehouses like Snowflake or BigQuery
Partner with data engineers to define analytical schema requirements and help build dbt models that power downstream self-service BI tools
Conduct deep-dive exploratory data analyses to diagnose business performance anomalies, identify growth drivers, and present findings to leadership
Establish data governance best practices, ensuring clear documentation of metric definitions, data lineage, and dashboard ownership

3–6 years of experience working as a data analyst, business analyst, or analytics engineer in a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment
Advanced SQL skills, with deep knowledge of analytical window functions, complex joins, CTEs, and query optimization techniques
Proven experience building scalable data models and intuitive dashboards using BI tools such as Tableau, Looker (LookML), or Power BI
Solid understanding of SaaS business metrics, including ARR, LTV, CAC, retention rates, and cohort analysis
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
Bonus: Experience with dbt (data build tool), Python/R for basic data manipulation, or git-based version control workflows

About The Tepa Companies

Established in 2005 and owned by the Paskenta Band of Nomlaki Indians, The Tepa Companies deliver comprehensive and sustainable solutions to federal, state, local, and private-sector clients throughout the United States. The tribally owned companies work independently and collaboratively to provide wide-ranging construction, engineering, environmental, industrial, staffing, and technology services.

When you join Tepa Companies, you have the opportunity to expand your entrepreneurial skill set while growing professionally alongside the best in the industry. You will have the opportunity to impact your team, the organization as a whole, and subsequently, our Tribe.

We seek out top talent to provide the best services for our clients. We focus on being a responsible company for our employees and their families by creating a culture that reflects our core values and offering competitive pay and benefits package. Our benefits package includes comprehensive medical, dental, vision, generous paid time off and holidays, 401(k) plan with company match, life insurance, flexible spending and health savings account, mental health support and resources, short and long-term disability, and tuition reimbursement.

LOCATION: This is a remote position and can be based from any location within the United States.

Salary Range: $115,000.00 - $140,000.00

About The Job

The Tepa Companies are seeking a Senior Solutions Engineer to lead and support our customers’ and project managers’ GIS tasks and activities. This role provides technical leadership and support in the areas of geospatial requirements gathering solution design/implementation, GIS system integration, software deployments, GIS system administration, troubleshooting and training. The Senior Solutions Engineer leads small to medium sized efforts (at times including the activities of technical resources on those projects) to ensure successful completion and typically will have significant interaction with client staff, Tepa project managers and other technical resources. This role often assists project managers by managing significant portions of technical projects and client relationships.

Job Functions

Provides advanced geospatial expertise to managers, clients and technical staff
Leads technical discussions both internally and with customer teams, including requirements gathering, solution design, testing and training
Provides and document reviews, recommendations, procedures and designs in support of Tepa and client enterprise GIS activities along with the technologies that often integrate with GIS
Advises the selection of technological purchases, with regards to system specifications and requirements relevant to geospatial processing, data storage, data access, data acquisition, etc.
Creates standards and procedures for geospatial projects, data and applications and database structures and relationships
Works alongside project managers to successfully monitor progress and implementation of initiatives
Advises on the feasibility of potential future projects to management and create written content for technical proposals and cost/effort estimates
Occasionally manages small to medium sized technical projects and client relationships
Mentors other technical staff and proactively share knowledge, skills and information
Regularly designs, deploys and/or troubleshoots Esri server technologies at a System Administrator level of skill

What We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s Degree in GIS, Geography, Engineering, Information Technology or related field
Ability to obtain a security clearance, Transportation Working Identification Card (TWIC) or similar, which typically requires proof of U.S. Citizenship and a background check
8+ years of experience in implementation, administration and advanced usage of geospatial applications
Significant advanced experience with the Esri ArcGIS suite of applications and solutions, including server-side Enterprise technologies and Web GIS Application creation and administration (e.g. ArcGIS Experience Builder, Survey 123, etc.)
Power-user skills with Esri’s ArcGIS Pro and experience with scripting languages such as Python, ArcPy, and Arcade expressions
Experience with mobile and field data capture technologies (e.g. GPS, Lidar, Esri Field Maps, etc.)
Experience deploying, configuring and troubleshooting Esri server technologies (e.g. ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Server, etc.)
Ability to prioritize required tasks to meet multiple schedule deadlines
Advanced understanding of business analysis techniques and processes
Ability to work with various departments to facilitate the orderly execution of a proposed project plan
Excellent verbal and written communication skills for requirements gathering, system documentation, training and other collaborative activities

Preferred

Hands on professional experience performing or leading Geospatial System integration activities
Significant experience designing/deploying/administering Esri Server technologies such as ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Server
Consulting experience
Experience with Enterprise IT processes, systems and terminology
Experience with SQL and/or PostgreSQL for database administration
Esri Professional level certifications
Certificates and/or experience related to Cloud technologies, System Architecture, Cybersecurity

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Agency Description

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.

As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.

Your Team

The Division of Building and Land Development Services (BLDS) leads the agency’s effort in providing architectural, engineering, cost valuation, environmental planning, and construction support services to the various divisions within HPD’s Office of Development. The Office of Development utilizes a public-private partnership model and provides loans, grants, and/or incentives to assist in the finance of housing development projects that will benefit low- and moderate-income New Yorkers.

BLDS is the largest division within the Office of Development with over 100 staff, and is composed of seven units, including: the Bureau of New Construction Design Services, the Bureau of Preservation Design Services, the Bureau of Engineering, the Bureau of Construction Services, the Environmental Planning Unit, the Program Management Unit, and the Executive Office.

Your Impact

As Data Analyst, you will report to the Deputy Director of Analytics, within the BLDS Executive Office. You will work with the six other BLDS units to facilitate the analysis of internal and cross-agency data, while identifying trends in housing development projects. In addition, you will develop metrics and prepare reports and analyses related to performance evaluation, compliance, projects, or other initiatives.

Your Role

The ideal candidate should have a Bachelor’s or Graduate Degree in a relevant field of study, such as Data Science, Urban Planning, or Public Administration. The ideal candidate will have superior data synthesis and management skills and be adept at utilizing data management tools.

Your Responsibilities

Data management: maintaining regular reporting and analyses, including bi/weekly MMR reports, project summary analyses, and annual reports.
Performance management & evaluation: developing metrics on internal (BLDS) and external (Architects, Contractors, etc.) performance and workloads, resulting in new or updated analyses and summary reports, among others.
Creating data visualization tools and materials for presentations.

LOCATION: This is a remote position and can be based from any location within the United States.

The Tepa Companies are seeking a Senior Solutions Engineer to lead and support our customers’ and project managers’ GIS tasks and activities. This role provides technical leadership and support in the areas of geospatial requirements gathering solution design/implementation, GIS system integration, software deployments, GIS system administration, troubleshooting and training. The Senior Solutions Engineer leads small to medium sized efforts (at times including the activities of technical resources on those projects) to ensure successful completion and typically will have significant interaction with client staff, Tepa project managers and other technical resources. Provides advanced geospatial expertise to managers, clients and technical staff

Mentors other technical staff and proactively share knowledge, skills and information
Regularly designs, deploys and/or troubleshoots Esri server technologies at a System Administrator level of skill

Bachelor’s Degree in GIS, Geography, Engineering, Information Technology or related field
Ability to obtain a security clearance, Transportation Working Identification Card (TWIC) or similar, which typically requires proof of U.S. Citizenship and a background check

Hands on professional experience performing or leading Geospatial System integration activities

Experience with Enterprise IT processes, systems and terminology
Experience with SQL and/or PostgreSQL for database administration

Agency Description

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.

As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.

Your Team

The Division of Building and Land Development Services (BLDS) leads the agency’s effort in providing architectural, engineering, cost valuation, environmental planning, and construction support services to the various divisions within HPD’s Office of Development. The Office of Development utilizes a public-private partnership model and provides loans, grants, and/or incentives to assist in the finance of housing development projects that will benefit low- and moderate-income New Yorkers.

BLDS is the largest division within the Office of Development with over 100 staff, and is composed of seven units, including: the Bureau of New Construction Design Services, the Bureau of Preservation Design Services, the Bureau of Engineering, the Bureau of Construction Services, the Environmental Planning Unit, the Program Management Unit, and the Executive Office.

Your Impact

As Data Analyst, you will report to the Deputy Director of Analytics, within the BLDS Executive Office. You will work with the six other BLDS units to facilitate the analysis of internal and cross-agency data, while identifying trends in housing development projects. In addition, you will develop metrics and prepare reports and analyses related to performance evaluation, compliance, projects, or other initiatives.

Your Role

The ideal candidate should have a Bachelor’s or Graduate Degree in a relevant field of study, such as Data Science, Urban Planning, or Public Administration. The ideal candidate will have superior data synthesis and management skills and be adept at utilizing data management tools.

Your Responsibilities

Data management: maintaining regular reporting and analyses, including bi/weekly MMR reports, project summary analyses, and annual reports.
Performance management & evaluation: developing metrics on internal (BLDS) and external (Architects, Contractors, etc.) performance and workloads, resulting in new or updated analyses and summary reports, among others.
Creating data visualization tools and materials for presentations.
Maintenance of BLDS’ data systems, including monitoring reports, updating user guides and other informational documents, providing technical/procedural guidance, and troubleshooting, as needed.
Brainstorming ways to improve the integration of BLDS’ data systems and datasets.
Gathering and synthesizing data from several different sources.
Participating in special projects, as necessary.

Preferred Skills

Resourceful, proactive, and willing to learn new hard and soft skills; creative problem-solving and ability to think independently.
Excellent communication, writing, critical thinking, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, ability to multi-task to meet deadlines, and ability to execute tasks independently.
Attention to detail in working with large datasets that may not always be familiar.
Ability to communicate and work effectively with diverse technical specialists, and ability to learn and translate technical language into digestible and concise information for a wider audience.
Experience with creating data visualization tools, and familiarity with SharePoint and SAS, Python, or other programming software/language. Coding experience is big a plus. Candidate may be asked to provide work samples.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, demonstrating high proficiency in Excel; candidate may be requested to provide work samples or to take a short test to demonstrate abilities.
Previous experience in housing, architecture, construction, and related fields is a plus.

Candidate may be subject to a background investigation conducted by the New York City Department of Investigation.

Authorization to work in the United States is required for this position. The NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development does not provide sponsorship for international employees for visa applications, extensions, or status changes, including H-1B visas. Applicants are responsible for ensuring that they meet all qualifying requirements for this position at the time of application.
